item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00431","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C03","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.78,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 plausibly supplied a material property-disposition template. Both directives use a sequence of recitals explaining the status and intended use of specifically described federal lands, followed by an operative reservation of the described property and a provision assigning the Secretary of the Interior authority to dispose of or administer it under cited law. The child substantially expands and adapts that machinery to Guam, multiple property classes, and several agencies. C03 has related land-jurisdiction transfer language, while C15 supplies Guam-specific administrative context, but neither matches the child's combined reservation-and-disposition structure as closely as C08.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The following-described real and personal property of the United States in Guam is hereby reserved to the United States and placed under the control and jurisdiction of the Secretary of the Navy","parent_excerpt":"The following-described public lands are hereby eliminated from Naval Petroleum Reserve NO. 2, California, and reserved for townsite purposes","explanation":"Both use the same operative frame—identifying following-described federal property and formally reserving it for a stated governmental purpose."},{"child_excerpt":"The following-described real property of the United States in Guam is hereby reserved to the United States and transferred to the administrative supervision of the Secretary of the Interior, and shall be available for disposition by the Secretary of the Interior in his discretion","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Interior is hereby authorized and directed to dispose of the said lands in accordance with the provisions of section 2381 of the Revised Statutes of the United States.","explanation":"Both couple a land reservation with statutory disposition authority vested in the Secretary of the Interior."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS certain other hereinafter described real property ... should remain available for disposition by the Secretary of the Interior","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS it is deemed desirable and in the public interest that the lands hereinafter described ... be made available for townsite purposes and for disposal under appropriate townsite laws","explanation":"The recitals perform the same drafting function: justify keeping specifically described lands available for a later legally authorized disposition."}]}
